$Comment: Skill XP added to what each step of Old Jack's questline pays: the Hallows_Eve_Chain_Pay table,
on a server running MMO Skill Tree.
ContributesTo folds these rolls into that table without touching its file, so the table's own
sweets and bombs are tuned there alone. Requires takes this file out on a server without MMO
Skill Tree, so the table pays exactly what its own file says there; always write it with Min 1.
Rolls only, never a Pool: a pool entry here would join the table's own draw and change its odds.
A roll with no Chance always pays. The XP goes to Artillery, the Lantern Bomb's skill, and Amount
is XP before any boost. How the reward reads on screen is the Mmo_Xp reward kind's own file.
Name: Mmo_Hallows_Eve_Chain_Pay
